scope: Shared Linux Docker ABI, source-worker I/O and shared iPad/Mac terminals

worker_contract: caught SIGIO and sigreturn retire on source worker with zero service requests
AIO returns the only execution slot and survives cohort handoff with zero service requests
destroyed AIO contexts do not retarget reused identifiers

limits: Legacy AIO is buffered; io_submit waits for its accepted batch while yielding the CPU slot
FASYNC supports pipes, Unix sockets and PTYs; native TCP returns EOPNOTSUPP
Lifecycle, other signal sources and existing masked/owner wait boundaries remain
